# Hooxie

Hooxie is a Windows overlay by Delexo for developers who already use a coding agent. It stays on the screen and can stay off a screen share. It costs $5.99 once for the computer that buys it.

- [Home](https://hooxie.com/)
- [Documentation](https://hooxie.com/docs)
- [Help](https://hooxie.com/help)
- [Release notes](https://hooxie.com/releases)
- [Contact](https://hooxie.com/contact)
- [Legal](https://hooxie.com/legal)
